source_semantics.visibility: The AI Center Proposed value panel renders Copy only while _output is non-empty/non-whitespace.
source_semantics.clipboard_transition: CopyOutputAsync awaits navigator.clipboard.writeText with the exact current _output value and only after that awaited browser operation succeeds raises the localized Suggestion copied notification.
source_semantics.failure_boundary: If the browser clipboard write fails, source execution does not reach the success notification.
source_semantics.side_effects: Copy output is browser-session-only behavior: it performs no persistence, server mutation, approval mutation, AI-provider call, WordPress call, queue operation, navigation, or fabricated external success.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/ai-center-approval-status-control.tsx extends the existing guarded AI Center host with an AIMW-AI-B711182657 Copy control inside a source-equivalent Proposed value panel.
laravel_adaptation.visibility: The control is absent while the component-local current output is empty/whitespace and appears only for a non-empty current output value.
laravel_adaptation.clipboard: The handler requires navigator.clipboard.writeText, passes the exact unmodified current output, awaits the returned promise, prevents duplicate concurrent writes, and enters success state only after the promise resolves.
laravel_adaptation.truthful_failure: Rejected writes or an unavailable Clipboard API render a failure state and never render Suggestion copied success.
laravel_adaptation.network_boundary: The Copy click performs no apiRequest/fetch, carries no tenant/site/provider/approval/resource identifier, and advertises no server mutation action contract.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: The control exists only inside the current AI Center host when FrontendContext includes ai.use; missing ai.use fails closed.
laravel_adaptation.sibling_boundaries: This operation does not claim Generate. Focused acceptance supplies current output as component-local state, proves Clear history preserves it, and proves the already-terminal New session transition clears it as the source Clear() contract requires.

tenant_isolation.render_boundary: The AI Center host is reached through the authenticated tenant shell and authoritative /tenants/{tenant}/context contract.
tenant_isolation.cross_tenant_boundary: Focused Laravel acceptance proves an Alpha-only authenticated member receives 404 for Beta AI Center/context routes.
tenant_isolation.id_surface: The clipboard handler accepts no tenant, approval, site, content, provider, or other caller-supplied resource identifier and creates no direct-ID/IDOR surface.
